sent_to_model:
i'm at SXSW and need some help getting my blog caught up before another shift at the trade show. there's been so much running around, seeing bands and bumping into people that i'm already losing track. can you put together a diary post about the daytime encounters and last night's shows, including what i thought of the performances? i also want to tell people about hanging out with tom and how completely exhausted i ended up. there's a saturday gig i'd like readers to know about too. a couple of the band reports will have to wait, but i want to get the rest posted now. leave promises of later reports for the go and aptbs, and include the elevator aside for bidi.

- Diary date: march 17, wednesday, at SXSW; covering daytime activity and the evening.
- dirty on purpose has a saturday show at the hook, sharing the bill with dennis cahlo and surefire.
- Daniel couldn't get out of dallas; our plan to meet for his showcase fell through. He's the person who introduced me to cass mccombs.
- cass mccombs played la zona rosa. The ASCAP showcase at hard rock cafe included the go, the dresden dolls, and a place to bury strangers.
- Bought a cass mccombs tee shirt as support. Still playing 'so damn pure' repeatedly on my ipod.
- Encountered isaac at our hotel; he's lodging with dawn.
- Met christi, who works with sxsw and apparently is rhett miller's sister. Really friendly.
- Lunch companion: tom, who books shows for the hook.
- Set up our trade-show booth and attended soundcheck.
- a place to bury strangers is tim's band; justin plays drums.
- arthur and michael, both from stellastarr*, came for aptbs. Also spent a little time chatting with lio from kanine.
- Elevator conversation about seeing max, from natural history, at the fader/levis party: two fellow passengers knew him. Apparently one was spoon's britt daniel.
- Brief street sighting of the walkmen; couldn't stop to greet them.
- Tom stayed with me through the evening. Attempted the von bondies, found an enormous queue, then returned to ASCAP.
- justin took his shirt off while drumming and was very sweaty. arthur was present; I mentioned the resemblance to his own performances and he laughed.
- Heels became unbearable after an evening on my feet. Returned to the hotel worn out; decided future SXSW outings require different shoes.
- Tom and I passed large groups of birds congregating in treetops, with droppings falling below.
- Hurried to sea ray because it had been ages since my last show of theirs. Excited to catch them in texas; crowded room.
- Unsure whether I missed part of cass mccombs's set; swayed during the performance.
- sea ray's improvement was enormous. Excellent songs, background visuals, expansive atmospheric sound; the combination felt almost overpowering.
- cass mccombs was lovely live, though the record feels dreamier. Adore 'so damn pure'; want more chances to see him and sing along.
- Loved the dresden dolls. Amanda was very sweet.
- Tom was excellent company for a night of music. Had a terrific evening despite ending up completely drained.
- Leave brief promises of later reports for the go and aptbs; those individual reviews aren't ready.
- Only time for a quick update before returning to trade-show duties and more drinking. Include the elevator aside for bidi.

(About me: music blogger working at SXSW. Length: it should come to roughly 400-800 words.)
